Lens vs Le Havre: Live Stream & Watch Online

In what promises to be an engaging encounter in Ligue 1, Lens will welcome Le Havre to the Stade Bollaert-Delelis on January 30, 2026. Both teams are striving for crucial points as they seek to solidify their standings in the league. With Lens currently aiming for European qualification and Le Havre fighting to stay clear of the relegation zone, fans can expect an intense battle between two sides with different ambitions. Kick-off: 30.01.2026, 19:45 UTC / 22:45 MSK
Stadium: Stade Bollaert-Delelis
Competition: Ligue 1

Match Preview

Lens are enjoying a solid season thus far, currently placing themselves in the top ranks of Ligue 1, where they have shown their determination to compete with the league’s elite. Under the guidance of their coach, the team has displayed an attractive attacking style, scoring a commendable number of goals while maintaining decent defensive solidity. On the other hand, Le Havre's journey this season has been somewhat turbulent. With an unpredictable form that has fluctuated between impressive performances and disappointing results, they find themselves near the bottom of the standings. Their upcoming match will be vital in defining their season; a victory could provide a crucial boost in confidence and standing as they aim to avoid relegation.

Team Form and Analysis

Lens

Lens has been bolstered by strong performances from their key players, notably the prolific attacking pair who have showcased their ability to find the back of the net consistently. However, they are facing minor injury concerns, with a couple of players expected to miss out on this fixture. Despite this, the manager will likely lean on their robust home support to motivate the squad, aiming to capitalize on Le Havre's defensive vulnerabilities.

Le Havre

Le Havre's campaign has been marred by inconsistencies, and they will need to rediscover their form ahead of this critical match. Injuries have also affected their lineup, with some pivotal players struggling to return to fitness. The coach might deploy a more conservative approach, focusing on compact defending and quick counterattacks to exploit Lens's offensive pushes.
